ceiling_directive: Prove an exact hardness classification for promised rational COMP-EDGE instances, with the reduction preserving canonicality, minimality, and rank-faithfulness.
improvement_directive: Resolve the deferred unrestricted minimum-completion problem by proving NP-hardness or supplying a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm, including prescribed-pair optimization and recovery of the plateau instance's complete minimizer projection.
critique: The complete effect image is proved only after defining each feasible-pair set P_g by membership in the unknown global argmin, so the result is principally an algebraic projection of Yang et al.'s already-enumerated DOG class rather than a constructive general certificate. Unrestricted minimum completion remains open; promise-NP membership, an FP^NP upper envelope, and exhaustive enumeration under block-diagonal fixed interaction width do not classify or scalably solve the coupled problem. The q+1 sharpness result and singleton minor tests are counting and equality consequences of the normalized-column representation, which are too narrow to lift this companion result to field level by themselves. Any suggestion of delivered confidence-region inference is underfulfilled because the note assumes an external region C_n and proves only event-inclusion coverage transfer, without constructing that region, establishing a uniform first-stage limit theorem, or providing practical evidence; these omissions also cap the projected paper score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5.8 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
